# This test verifies that MMA correctly upgrades store disposition based on
# disk utilization thresholds, independent of load balancing (CPU/write bandwidth).
#
# Key insight: There is NO workload in this test. CPU and write bandwidth are
# perfectly balanced (all zeros). MMA's only motivation to move replicas is the
# disk utilization-based disposition upgrade in updateStoreStatuses:
# - Stores above kv.allocator.max_disk_utilization_threshold (0.95)
#   get ReplicaDispositionShedding (actively shed replicas)
# - Stores above kv.allocator.rebalance_to_max_disk_utilization_threshold (0.925)
#   get ReplicaDispositionRefusing (won't accept new replicas)
#
# Setup: 5-node cluster with 10GiB stores. Initially ranges are evenly placed.
# At t=0, we set s1's capacity to simulate 96% disk usage (above shed threshold)
# and s2's capacity to simulate 93% disk usage (above refuse threshold).
#
# Expected behavior (driven purely by disposition, not load balancing):
# - s1 (96%): Should actively shed replicas (disposition = Shedding)
# - s2 (93%): Should not accept new replicas (disposition = Refusing), stays at 9
# - s3, s4, s5: Should receive replicas from s1 (disposition = OK)
gen_cluster nodes=5 store_byte_capacity_gib=10
----

setting split_queue_enabled=false
----

setting replicate_queue_enabled=false
----

# 15 ranges with 3 replicas each, evenly distributed = 9 replicas per store
# NOTE: No gen_load command - CPU and write bandwidth are all zeros/balanced.
# Any replica movement is purely due to disk utilization disposition.
gen_ranges ranges=15 bytes_mib=100 repl_factor=3 placement_type=even
----

# Store 1: 96% disk utilization (above 95% shed threshold)
# Total capacity = 10GiB, used = 9.6GiB, available = 0.4GiB
# 9.6 GiB = 10,307,921,510 bytes, available = 429,496,729 bytes
set_capacity store=1 capacity=10737418240 available=429496729
----

# Store 2: 93% disk utilization (above 92.5% refuse threshold, below 95% shed)
# Total capacity = 10GiB, used = 9.3GiB, available = 0.7GiB
# 9.3 GiB = 9,985,003,322 bytes, available = 752,414,918 bytes
set_capacity store=2 capacity=10737418240 available=752414918
----

# s1 (96% full) should shed replicas - expect fewer than initial 9
# s2 (93% full) should refuse new replicas but NOT shed (stays at 9)
# s3, s4, s5 should gain replicas from s1
assertion type=stat stat=replicas stores=(1) upper_bound=6 ticks=6
----

# Verify MMA sheds replicas from s1 based purely on disk utilization disposition.
# With no workload, CPU and write bandwidth are balanced - only disk util drives movement.
# Results show:
# - s1 (96%): 9 → 6 replicas (shedding due to disposition)
# - s2 (93%): stays at 9 (refuses new replicas, doesn't receive from s1)
# - s3/s4/s5 (9%): 9 → 10 each (receive replicas from s1)
eval duration=6m seed=42 metrics=(disk_fraction_used,replicas,leases) cfgs=(mma-only)
----
disk_fraction_used#1: first: [s1=0.96, s2=0.93, s3=0.09, s4=0.09, s5=0.09] (stddev=0.39, mean=0.45, sum=2)
